title: Color vision test
what: You are shown pictures made of colored dots with numbers or shapes hidden in them. This checks how well your eyes tell colors apart.
why: For a work medical exam, a driver's medical certificate, school, or if a person mixes up colors.
duration: usually 5 to 10 minutes; results right away
tell_doctor: If you wear glasses or contact lenses
If a color vision problem was found before
If any relatives have color vision problems

prepare.title: Glasses
prepare.text: Bring your glasses or contact lenses if you wear them for close-up vision.

prepare.title: Rest
prepare.text: Come well rested, not after a sleepless night.

bring: Your glasses, if you wear them
Your referral or medical exam form
steps: You are shown charts with colored circles
You say the number or trace the shape
Usually both eyes are tested together, sometimes each one separately
The doctor writes down the result
feel: Some pictures can be hard to see. This is normal. Answer with what you see
after: You get the result right away
If there are changes, the doctor will explain what this means for your work or driver's license

faq.a: It is not worth it. There are many charts, and the doctor can tell. An honest result matters.
A color vision problem you are born with cannot be treated, but people live normal lives with it.

reminders.text: Color vision test tomorrow. Bring your glasses and your medical exam form.
